name: Pipeliners - Blog Keyword Alignment 2026-09-23
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-23

# Summary
Work folder for the Sep 23, 2026 blog focus keyword alignment. Every live blog post was given one focus keyword chosen from its own 90-day Google searches plus volume and difficulty, and that keyword was placed in the title, meta description, H1, first 100 words and at least one subheading. Results report: `pipeliners-blog-keywords.html` (checked live on desktop and Googlebot mobile Sep 24).

# Key findings
- 38 posts checked live; 37 aligned in all five places; 0 slugs changed.
- Head terms owned by service pages were avoided (hydro jetting, leak detection, trenchless sewer repair).
- Where needed, a short "Quick answer" (2 to 3 sentences from facts already in the post) and one renamed or added subheading were added. Titles, metas and social text were updated in OTTO and pages refreshed one at a time. Old titles and content were saved for rollback.
- Examples: "sewer line leak" (170 a month, difficulty 20) for the 14 warning signs post; "plumbing maintenance" for the 2025 guide; "root intrusion", "corroded pipes", "collapsed sewer line", "gurgling drains", "how long do cast iron pipes last".

# Decisions and status
- Needs Kim's eye: the cost post quotes $3,800 to $15,800, a 20-year warranty and 50+ year life (Scott to confirm; not repeated); two lining-vs-replacement posts split by angle, merge later would be stronger; two keywords contain "pipe lining"; one post's meta could not be changed in OTTO.
- Not touched on purpose: both myths posts (hold), the residential restoration guide (waiting on Scott), the pipeline locating post (Kim's call), and 9 merged posts.
- Edits landed inside the Sep 19 merge measurement window (results check Oct 17).

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `pipeliners-blog-keywords.html`, `tracker_live.html`, `overview.txt` (heading and intro dump per post), `done_ids.txt` (11 post IDs), plan and OTTO batch JSON, before/after HTML, PHP, Python and shell scripts.
